# MCP tool reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:tools` from the running server. Do not edit by hand: a test fails when this file is out of date. -->

The server offers **30 tools** and **2 prompts**. Coordinates start at (0,0) in the top-left corner.
Map cells are `x` (column) and `y` (row); entity positions are in map **pixels**. Tile numbers in maps are 1-based (`0` means empty).
Tools never throw: a problem comes back as an error result with a message you can act on.

See the [MCP guide](mcp-guide.md) for how to connect and for worked examples.

## Project

### `project_info`

Summarize the open project: name, tile size, and the ids of all sheets, animations, tilesets and maps.

_No parameters._

### `project_validate`

Check the whole project: every tileset and animation must reference an existing sheet and frame, and every map must pass map_validate. Run after sprite_slice, which replaces frame ids.

_No parameters._

## Sprites and drawing

### `sprite_import`

Import a PNG from an absolute path on disk into the project (copied to assets/<id>.png) and register it as a sprite sheet with no frames. Follow with sprite_slice.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `sourcePath` | string | yes | Absolute path to a PNG file |

### `sprite_slice`

Cut a sheet into a regular grid of frames (ids '<sheetId>_<n>', row-major from 0). Replaces existing frames, so tilesets/animations that reference old frame ids must be re-checked with map_validate.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sheetId` | string | yes |  |
| `frameWidth` | integer (1..) | yes |  |
| `frameHeight` | integer (1..) | yes |  |
| `margin` | integer (0..) | no |  |
| `spacing` | integer (0..) | no |  |

### `sheet_get`

Read a sprite sheet: image path, grid settings and its frames (id, rect).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |

### `sheet_delete`

Delete a sprite sheet, the animations built from it, and (unless deleteImage is false) its PNG. Refuses while a tileset uses the sheet; delete that first.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `deleteImage` | boolean | no | Also delete assets/<id>.png (default true) |

### `sprite_create`

Create a new blank (transparent) pixel image and register it as a sprite sheet with no frames. Then draw with sprite_draw and look with sprite_preview. Slice with sprite_slice when done.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `width` | integer (1..512) | yes |  |
| `height` | integer (1..512) | yes |  |

### `sprite_draw`

Draw on a sprite sheet's image with a batch of ops applied in order: clear, pixels, rect, line, ellipse (cx,cy is the centre in pixel units; add 0.5 to centre on a pixel), fill (flood), and rows (ASCII art + legend - the best way to place detailed pixels). Later ops paint over earlier ones, so draw big shapes first and details last. To make animation frames, lay frames side by side in one sheet and use copy with rowShift to derive each frame from frame 0 (e.g. a sine of the row height for a sway). Saves the PNG and returns how many pixels changed; use sprite_preview to look at the result.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sheetId` | string | yes |  |
| `ops` | op[] | yes |  |

**`ops` items** (each has an `op`):

- `"clear"` (no fields)
- `"pixels"`

  | Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `points` | object[] | yes |  |
  | `color` | string | yes | "#rgb", "#rrggbb", "#rrggbbaa" or "transparent" |

- `"rect"`

  | Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `x` | integer | yes |  |
  | `y` | integer | yes |  |
  | `w` | integer (1..) | yes |  |
  | `h` | integer (1..) | yes |  |
  | `color` | string | yes | "#rgb", "#rrggbb", "#rrggbbaa" or "transparent" |
  | `filled` | boolean | no |  |

- `"line"`

  | Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `x1` | integer | yes |  |
  | `y1` | integer | yes |  |
  | `x2` | integer | yes |  |
  | `y2` | integer | yes |  |
  | `color` | string | yes | "#rgb", "#rrggbb", "#rrggbbaa" or "transparent" |

- `"ellipse"`

  | Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `cx` | number | yes |  |
  | `cy` | number | yes |  |
  | `rx` | number | yes |  |
  | `ry` | number | yes |  |
  | `color` | string | yes | "#rgb", "#rrggbb", "#rrggbbaa" or "transparent" |
  | `filled` | boolean | no |  |

- `"fill"`

  | Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `x` | integer | yes |  |
  | `y` | integer | yes |  |
  | `color` | string | yes | "#rgb", "#rrggbb", "#rrggbbaa" or "transparent" |

- `"copy"`

  | Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `x` | integer | yes |  |
  | `y` | integer | yes |  |
  | `w` | integer (1..) | yes |  |
  | `h` | integer (1..) | yes |  |
  | `dx` | integer | yes |  |
  | `dy` | integer | yes |  |
  | `rowShift` | number[] | no | Per source row, shift sideways by N pixels (shear). Length h. Positive = right. |
  | `flipX` | boolean | no |  |
  | `flipY` | boolean | no |  |
  | `keepDest` | boolean | no | Do not clear the destination first (default clears it) |

- `"rows"`

  | Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `x` | integer | yes |  |
  | `y` | integer | yes |  |
  | `rows` | string[] | yes |  |
  | `legend` | map of string | yes | One-character keys. Characters not in the legend are left untouched, so '.' can mean 'skip'. |

### `sprite_get`

Read pixels as text: ASCII rows plus a legend (symbol -> color, '.' = transparent). Use it to inspect or to copy a region. Optionally limit to a region.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sheetId` | string | yes |  |
| `region` | object | no |  |

### `sprite_preview`

Render a sprite sheet image enlarged (nearest-neighbour) on a checkerboard so you can look at your drawing. Call it after drawing to judge and refine.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sheetId` | string | yes |  |
| `scale` | integer (1..32) | no |  |

## Tilesets and animations

### `tileset_create`

Create a tileset from a sheet. Tile number n in map layers is tiles[n-1]. Defaults to every frame in order; pass frameIds to pick and order them.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `sheetId` | string | yes |  |
| `frameIds` | string[] | no |  |
| `collisionFrameIds` | string[] | no | Frames whose tiles block movement |

### `tile_set_properties`

Set collision and/or tags on one tile of a tileset (tile is the 1-based number used in maps).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tilesetId` | string | yes |  |
| `tile` | integer (1..) | yes |  |
| `collision` | boolean | no |  |
| `tags` | string[] | no |  |
| `terrain` | string | no | Autotile group name; empty string clears it |
| `mask` | integer (0..15) | no | N=1,E=2,S=4,W=8: which neighbours are the same terrain |

### `animation_create`

Create an animation from frames of a sheet. Give frameIds plus fps for uniform timing, or frames with per-frame durationMs.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `sheetId` | string | yes |  |
| `frameIds` | string[] | no |  |
| `fps` | number (1..120) | no |  |
| `frames` | object[] | no |  |
| `loop` | boolean | no |  |
| `tags` | string[] | no |  |

### `tileset_define_terrain`

Mark tiles of a tileset as one autotile terrain in a single call. Each entry gives the 1-based tile number and its mask (N=1, E=2, S=4, W=8 = neighbours of the same terrain; 15 = fully surrounded, 0 = isolated). Then use map_autotile to paint with it. A full set has 16 tiles (one per mask); missing masks fall back to mask 15.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tilesetId` | string | yes |  |
| `terrain` | string | yes |  |
| `tiles` | object[] | yes |  |

## Maps

### `map_create`

Create an empty map with one tile layer named 'ground'. Fails if the id already exists.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `width` | integer (1..512) | yes |  |
| `height` | integer (1..512) | yes |  |
| `tilesetId` | string | yes | Tileset used by the initial layer |
| `tileSize` | integer | no | Defaults to the project tile size |

### `map_get`

Read a map. Tile layers are returned as an array of rows (strings of space-separated tile ids) so the grid is easy to read. Pass layerId to limit output.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `layerId` | string | no |  |

### `map_set_tiles`

Set individual cells on a tile or collision layer in one batch (one undo step). Value 0 clears a cell.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `layerId` | string | yes |  |
| `cells` | object[] | yes |  |

### `map_fill`

Fill a rectangle (inclusive x,y, size w,h) on a tile or collision layer with one value. Use value 0 to erase.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `layerId` | string | yes |  |
| `x` | integer | yes |  |
| `y` | integer | yes |  |
| `w` | integer (1..) | yes |  |
| `h` | integer (1..) | yes |  |
| `value` | integer (0..) | yes |  |

### `layer_add`

Add a layer to a map. kind 'tile' needs tilesetId. New layers are appended on top.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `layerId` | string | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `kind` | "tile" \| "object" \| "collision" | yes |  |
| `tilesetId` | string | no |  |

### `entity_place`

Place an entity on an object layer at pixel coordinates. Replaces an entity with the same id.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `layerId` | string | yes |  |
| `entityId` | string | yes |  |
| `type` | string | yes |  |
| `x` | number | yes |  |
| `y` | number | yes |  |
| `props` | map of any | no |  |

### `map_validate`

Check a map for broken tileset references, tile ids beyond the tileset, duplicate ids and out-of-bounds entities.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |

### `map_render_preview`

Render the map to a PNG so you can look at the result. Uses real tile art when the tileset's sheet image exists, otherwise flat colors per tile id. Red X = collision, yellow cross = entity.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `scale` | integer (1..8) | no |  |

### `map_autotile`

Paint (or erase) an autotile terrain on a tile layer. You give the cells; edges, corners and neighbours are re-fitted automatically using the tileset's terrain masks (see tileset_define_terrain). Set erase=true to remove the terrain from those cells.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `layerId` | string | yes |  |
| `terrain` | string | yes | Terrain name defined in the layer's tileset |
| `cells` | object[] | yes |  |
| `erase` | boolean | no |  |

### `map_stamp`

Place a block of tile numbers with its top-left at (x,y). rows is a 2D array of tile numbers; 0 leaves that cell untouched, so shapes need not be rectangles. Ideal for multi-tile objects like the 3x4 tiles of a tree sliced from one sprite (row-major tile numbers). Cells outside the map are clipped.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |
| `layerId` | string | yes |  |
| `x` | integer | yes |  |
| `y` | integer | yes |  |
| `rows` | integer (0..)[][] | yes |  |

## Sprite requests

### `request_list`

List sprite requests the user queued from the editor's prompt builder (oldest first). Check this when asked to 'do the pending requests'.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | "pending" \| "in_progress" \| "done" \| "failed" | no |  |

### `request_claim`

Take the oldest pending sprite request (or a specific id) and mark it in progress. Returns the full prompt and spec: follow that prompt, then call request_complete. Says so if nothing is pending.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | no |  |

### `request_complete`

Mark a sprite request done once its sheet exists. The editor shows it as finished and links to the result.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `sheetId` | string | no | Defaults to the sheet id in the request |
| `note` | string | no |  |

### `request_fail`

Mark a sprite request as failed with a reason the user can read (for example: the subject is unclear).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |
| `reason` | string | yes |  |

## Export

### `export_tiled`

Export a map for the Tiled editor / engines with Tiled loaders: writes export/tiled/<mapId>.tmj plus one .tsj per tileset used. Collision layers become rectangle objects. Fails if a tile uses a missing frame or image.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes |  |

### `export_atlas`

Export a sprite sheet as an engine-ready atlas: export/atlas/<sheetId>.json (JSON-hash frames + meta, plus an `animations` block for this sheet's animations) and a copy of the PNG. Works with Phaser, PixiJS and similar loaders.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sheetId` | string | yes |  |

## Prompts

Prompts are ready-made briefs your client can offer as commands (in Claude Code they appear as `/mcp__<server>__<prompt>`).

### `draw_sprite`

A complete brief for drawing one sprite (or a short animation) with this editor's tools. Start from a preset (hero-walk, slime, chest, ...) and/or a style pack (pico8, gameboy, ...), then override anything.

| Argument | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `subject` | no | What to draw, e.g. 'a red slime with a tiny crown'. Optional when a preset is given. |
| `preset` | no | Preset id or name, e.g. 'hero-walk', 'slime', 'treasure chest' |
| `style_pack` | no | Style pack id or name: snes-rpg, nes, gameboy, pico8, sweetie16, dark-dungeon, bright-cute, neon |
| `size` | no | Pixels per frame, '32' or '32x24' (default: the preset's, else 32) |
| `frames` | no | Number of animation frames, 1-16 (default: the preset's, else 1) |
| `style` | no | nes, gameboy, snes or modern (default snes) |
| `sheet_id` | no | Id for the new sheet (default made from the subject) |

### `do_pending_requests`

Work through every sprite request queued in the editor's prompt builder.
